**Patient:** William, 75yo male. Condition: Seropositive Rheumatoid Arthritis with erosive joint changes.

**HPI:** Patient reports morning stiffness exceeding 1 hour, bilateral MCP joint swelling, elevated anti-CCP antibody levels (250 U/mL).  Reports pain and limited range of motion in both hands.

**Physical Exam:**  Patient presents with a palpable, tender MCP joint.  Palpable effusion noted.  Range of motion restricted.  Skin examination unremarkable.

**Management Plan:** Initiate NSAID therapy as prescribed. Monitor anti-CCP levels bi-weekly. Consider physical therapy to improve range of motion and pain management. Continue rheumatologist consultation for ongoing monitoring and potential disease modification strategies.
